Night over the small blue house, a soft music-box melody seems to float out of the bedroom window as golden notes of light.
Anna in nurse scrubs pauses in the dark hallway outside Mira's door, humming softly, then leaves for her night shift.
The archive at night, the jars hum gently like a choir, golden light.
An old round wooden door carved with musical notes slowly opens in the archive, warm golden light and floating notes spill out.
A circular library room full of tiny music boxes and glass jars, each with glowing floating musical notes inside, magical, warm.
The silver light pours out of Mira's lantern and flies between the music boxes, searching.
One small wooden music box on a shelf begins to glow silver and opens by itself, a tiny dancing star inside.
Warm golden memory: a young Anna rocking little Mira in her arms by a window at night, a man's silhouette beside them pointing at a star.
Suddenly the music room goes cold, jars dimming one by one, blue mist sliding under the door.
The shadow in the hat appears in the round doorway, the music stops, frost spreads over the floor.
The music box plays louder, a wave of golden musical notes bursts outward and pushes the frost and shadow away.
The shadow dissolves into smoke in the golden light, the jars brighten again.
Dawn approaches, the bright star fades over the rooftops, the lantern glows warm on the windowsill.
